data.last_assistant_message:
All pre-turn-boundary work is done. Archaeology on the transcript archive was inconclusive — the `transcripts-latest` tag doesn't exist and per-session transcript releases stop at 2026-04-05, but `persist-transcript.sh` posts to an out-of-scope repo with `curl -sf … 2>/dev/null`, so a proxy 403 would erase the evidence either way. The live test decides.

**State right now:** measurements for Q3, Q4, and the Fable arm are complete. The production Stop hook (`scripts/check-store-on-stop.py`) is instrumented to log every Stop event's stdin JSON to `/tmp/stop-hook-log.jsonl`, and a one-shot flag at `/tmp/stop-block-armed` will make it exit 2 with an injected directive on the next Stop — which is the end of this very message. If the mechanism works as documented, I'll be woken immediately by the blocked stop and will continue: verify the log, revert the instrumentation, and post the full verdict on issue #233.

If instead this session goes quiet after this message, that itself is the Q1 answer — **the Stop hook did not fire or exit 2 did not block** — and the next poke will get the verdict with that recorded (a `send_later` backstop was denied by the permission classifier, so there's no self-wake).

Ending this response now to trigger the Stop event.
